simple.summary: אַלְמָנוּת (ʼalmânûwth) means concrete, a widow ; abstract, widowhood First listed occurrence: 2Sam 20 3.

definitions.full: H491. almanuth [ אַלְמָנוּת ] noun feminine widowhood (Mishna id. , Phoenician אלמת ) suffix אַלְמְנוּתָהּ בִּגְדֵי her widow's garments Gen 38:14 , 19 ; construct חַיּוּת אַלְמְנוּת 2Sam 20:3 (of David's imprisoned concubines; but text impossible; ᵐ5 We חַיּוֺת אַלְמָנוֺת , compare Dr; Klo thinks gloss); figurative of Jerusalem Isa 54:4 אַלְמְנוּתַיִח .
